purpose: Diagnose the source/receiver discretization sensitivity of the PFFDTD dense sub-band worsening pattern: vary only the interpolation-stencil weight representation on the executed eight-node source/receiver stencils under the same frozen solver contract, and record whether the 34-frequency worsening pattern moves. Predeclared verbatim by docs/R130D_GENERAL3D_DENSE_FREQUENCY_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT_2026-10-03.md.

run76_record_binding.binding_rule: the canonical stencil cell evaluates the same persisted pressure/source records as authoritative run #76; a run that re-executes the pinned PFFDTD contract binds to those records by comparing the semantic sha256 of the recombined pressure trace and the unit discrete volume-velocity impulse source trace at every predeclared PPW level; variant cells are new executions and carry their own recorded trace digests
run76_record_binding.on_nonidentical: the computed sweep values are still emitted, but evaluation_state becomes NOT_EVALUATED_RECORD_BINDING_MISMATCH and the frozen classification is withheld so the result cannot be read as the run-76 experiment

stencil_sensitivity.axis: source/receiver discretization sensitivity: vary only the PFFDTD interpolation-stencil weight representation over the executed eight-node source/receiver stencils; node sets, geometry, grid, boundary, time sampling, duration, and scored contract are unchanged

stencil_variants.rule: the exact executed eight-node trilinear weight vector (in_alpha for source, out_alpha for receiver) recorded by the interpolation-stencil diagnostic; this is the control cell that binds the run-76 records
one-hot delta weights on the single stencil node nearest in Euclidean distance to the exact position, chosen within the executed stencil's eight nodes; ties resolve to the lowest stencil row index
uniform weight 1/8 on every node of the executed eight-node stencil (cell-centroid readout/injection)

execution.source_variant_rule: re-execute the pinned PFFDTD SimEngine on a byte-copied sim asset set (vox_out.h5, comms_out.h5, sim_consts.h5, sim_mats.h5) with only the comms in_sigs weight rows renormalized as in_sigs_variant[k,n] = alpha_variant[k] * sum_j in_sigs[j,n]; the total injected signal is invariant by construction because every variant weight vector sums to one, so geometry, grid, boundary, node sets, time samples and the injected source signal are identical to the canonical leg
execution.receiver_variant_rule: recombine the same executed raw u_out node traces post-hoc with the variant receiver weight vector; no additional solver execution
execution.canonical_cell_rule: reuse the canonical leg outputs that bind run76_record_binding
execution.invariant_check: the semantic sha256 of sum_j in_sigs[j,n] is recorded per source-variant run and must equal the canonical leg's for the run to evaluate

evaluation.frequency_grid_ref: the dense_frequency_neighborhood band grid of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan (34 frequencies, 36.0-44.0/76.0-84.0 Hz at 0.5 Hz)
evaluation.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f); the complete predeclared grid is evaluated for every cell with no post-result selection

per_cell_classification.rule: the dense worsening-count thresholds of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan applied to each cell independently

evaluation.pattern_metric: per-cell 34-frequency worsening vector compared to the canonical cell's vector; hamming_distance = count of frequencies whose worsening bit differs

classification.rule: invariant iff every evaluated non-canonical cell reproduces the canonical cell's worsening vector exactly; reclassified iff any evaluated non-canonical cell's dense classification differs from the canonical cell's; otherwise shifted
